note: Authoritative build manifest for The Glade. Each mod has a resolved, verified `url`, `source` (modrinth|curseforge), and hashes (Modrinth gives sha512; CurseForge pins on sha1). Two build sets derive from `side` (see .sides): client = all mods; server = side!=client. `side` here is the DISTRIBUTION decision (curated), not merely Modrinth’s declared env: e.g. Athena is a client-rendering lib but is marked `both` because Chipped hard-depends on it server-side; DistantHorizons/Oculus/Embeddium/MouseTweaks/3D-Skin-Layers are `client` (pure client, no server role); JEI is `both` (kept server-side for recipe sync). Modrinth URLs come from the v2 version_files bulk sha1 lookup; CurseForge URLs are the forgecdn path files/{fileId div 1000}/{fileId mod 1000}/{filename} (percent-encode filename metachars, e.g. [ ] as %5B %5D).

sides.server: mods to install on a dedicated server = every mod whose side != "client" (i.e. side in [both, server])
sides.client: mods to install on a player client = ALL mods (this pack was exported from a client instance, so the client set is the full list; the server set is the client set minus the pure-client jars marked side=client)
